info.name: Insurance Platform API
info.description:
Covers every Authentication flow: Client self-registration and login, staff logins (Agent/AgentAdmin/SupportAgent/SuperAdmin), USSD/WhatsApp channel-service login, channel-binding (a Portal-issued token must not work when presented as Mobile, and vice versa - see folder 2, requests 4-5), password reset, and login lockout.

SETUP FIRST:
1. Re-run Insurance_API_Schema.sql and Insurance_API_StoredProcs_Auth.sql in full (drop-and-recreate) - this collection needs the failed_login_attempts/locked_until columns, the three new/changed procs, and the seeded test staff users + channel-service accounts that ship with the schema now.
2. Set {{baseUrl}} below to wherever your API is actually running.
3. Set {{clientIdNo}}/{{clientEmail}}/{{clientPhone}}/{{clientPassword}} to a real, not-yet-registered person - self-registration needs somewhere to actually deliver an OTP.
4. OTPs are delivered via SCAPI (real email/SMS) - there is no way to read them back through the API by design (that would defeat the point of 2FA). Whenever a request's description says 'paste the real OTP', check the inbox/phone for that account, then edit the {{otpCode}} collection variable before running the next request.
5. Staff test accounts (id_no 90000001-90000004) all use password Test@1234 - see the seed block in Insurance_API_Schema.sql. Their seeded emails are fake @example.com addresses; update them to a real inbox in the database first if you want to actually receive their OTPs.

Folders 11-15 (added later) cover Catalog/Pricing, Quotes, Purchases/Payments and Commissions - run them in order (11 -> 12 -> 13 -> 14 -> 15), after folders 3 and 4 (Agent/AgentAdmin login) and folder 1/2 (Client self-registration) have already run at least once, since they depend on agentToken/agentAdminToken/clientToken/agentUserId/agentAdminUserId/clientChannel/clientIdNo being populated.
